name: Milestone Planning
description: Breaks a project goal into a milestone sequence with dependencies, durations, and critical path identification. Produces a milestone table with dates, owners, and completion criteria for each milestone. Use when the user asks about breaking a project into phases, creating a milestone plan, identifying project dependencies, or building a project timeline. Do NOT use for daily task scheduling (use daily-planning), full project kickoff documents (use project-kickoff), or enterprise program management (use business project-management skills).
